name: singlet_doublets_doublet_call_thresholding
title: Doublet score-to-call thresholding
description: Turns per-barcode doublet scores from doublets.expression_doublet_scoring into singlet, doublet or ambiguous calls, using a named cut rule and an expected doublet rate. Writes the calls, the cut or count used and per-library implied rates; it never recomputes scores. Use after scoring. Do not use it to rank barcodes or to merge several detectors (use doublets.ensemble_doublet_calling).

dataset.description: Dataset handle (.singlet path or URI, or workspace handle) holding the scored barcodes.

threshold_rule.description: Cut rule. expected_k and scdblfinder_auto need a rate; solo_prob applies to solo scores only.

score_method.description: Scoring output to read: obs/doublet_score_<method> and its simulated scores.

sample_key.description: obs column naming libraries; cuts are applied per library when set.

expected_rate.description: Expected multiplet fraction of called barcodes; null uses the Poisson table rate for the library size.

celltype_key.description: obs column of cell-type labels; when set, rate-based cuts use the heterotypic rate.

device.description: Execution device; the call step runs on CPU, so auto and cpu are equivalent.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace calls and diagnostics written by an earlier call with the same method.

stringency.description: Weight between false-negative and false-positive terms in the cut cost.

dbr_importance.description: Weight of the count-deviation term relative to misclassification.

expected_rate_sd.description: Spread of the expected rate; null uses max(0.02, 0.4 times the rate).

ambiguous_z.description: Calls with absolute z below this are labelled ambiguous; 0 disables the class.

miss_rate.description: Fraction of simulated doublets allowed below the cut.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: calls written; dry_run: estimate only; queued: long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, for example obs/doublet_call_scrublet. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: For completed runs: rule, threshold or k, libraries, n_barcodes, n_called, implied_rate, expected_rate_used, homotypic_adjusted.

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
